text:
emma: kicking off canary for release/2026-06-20 — routing 4% to embeddings + chat. change window 09:00-13:00 PT. i'll watch slo dashboards for 15m. release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-06-20 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary started — job=canary-2026-06-20-4pct target=embeds+chat routing=4% :rocket:

raj: seeing a p95 blip on embeddings.route to ~760ms at 177888, baseline ~290ms. error rate jumped from 0.06% -> 0.9% in the last 3m. dashboard: https://obs.redwood/dash/embeds-route

sre-oncall: Alert firing: slo_alert(embeds/p95>600ms,5m) for tag=canary. paste the alert query?

raj: query we use:
```
err = sum(rate(http_responses_total{route="/v1/embeddings",code!~"2..",deploy_tag="canary"}[5m]))
req = sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/embeddings",deploy_tag="canary"}[5m]))
err/req > 0.007
```

emma: traces show upstream 502s and worker logs with "oom-kill" messages on a subset of canary hosts. any config diffs in this release?

deploy-bot: Config diff: https://ci.redwood/config-diffs/2026-06-20/canary — notable: bump kvcache_prefill=true, soft_batch_ms 6 -> 20, and new model variant emb-v2-beta enabled on canary nodes.

raj: large soft_batch + kv prefill + new emb-v2-beta could explain memory pressure. recommend pause, pin model back to emb-v1.4.1 and reduce soft_batch_ms to 6 for canary pool.

sre-oncall: Agreed. Pause traffic first to limit customer impact, then patch. If error_rate > 1% after pause we consider full rollback.

emma: /deploy pause canary job=canary-2026-06-20-4pct (requested by emma)

deploy-bot: Canary paused. routing=0%. traces sampling increased. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/canary-2026-06-20/177888?idx=120

raj: applying hotfix: set service.embeddings.model="emb-v1.4.1" for canary, soft_batch_ms=6, kvcache_prefill=false. starting synthetic probe at 5 rps for 90s.

deploy-bot: config-change applied id=177888+43. synthetic job synthetic-verify-1778890005 started.

raj: synthetic probe metrics look good — p95 ~310ms, errors ~0.02%. no oom logs in traces.

sre-oncall: plan: resume to 1.5% for 10m with elevated sampling. thresholds: if error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 > 500ms -> page + rollback. rollback command is `deploy-bot rollback canary-2026-06-20 --full`.

emma: resuming to 1.5% now. /deploy resume canary job=canary-2026-06-20-4pct target=1.5% (requested by emma)

deploy-bot: Canary ramped to 1.5%. observability: high sampling, alert window=5m.

ops-notify: noting in release ticket REL-2026-06-20: "Mitigation: pinned embeddings to emb-v1.4.1 and reduced soft_batch_ms; disabled kvcache prefill on canary after memory/oom spike." https://internal.redwood/tasks/REL-2026-06-20

raj: adding postmortem todo: add preflight test that simulates kvcache prefill + increased soft_batch to catch memory regressions before rollout. also consider a canary mem-guard that keeps a per-host mem ceiling.

sre-oncall: i'll monitor for the next 20m and be ready to rollback if thresholds breach. thanks team for the quick triage.

emma: marking as PAUSED->PINNED->RESUMED(1.5%) in the ticket. will follow up with the postmortem action list after the change window. :thumbsup:
